name: the engaging pass measures before it sets html.mb-sph-on
why: The ported 9.99.1167 order, restored: offsets are read while <body> still has its disengaged margins, then the class lands and moves everything by them. Self-corrects only when a ResizeObserver round-trip triggers a second pass, so only a test that reads the engaging pass itself can see it; the settle-based tests cannot.

name: body-level chrome is no longer collected
why: Drops the MB top header, banners and footer from the targets. Content bars still pin, so a test asserting only h2/h3 would pass.

name: h3 sub-table bars are no longer collected
why: Only h2 bars are pinned; the multi-table page is the only place h3 bars exist in this spec.

name: the expanded-sidebar gate is dropped
why: Engages with the native sidebar expanded and no auto-resize, which pushes the sidebar to the far right end of the widened page.
grep: stays inert while the sidebar is expanded

name: a bar's own margin-right is not subtracted
why: WIP.2: sticky keeps the MARGIN box inside the containing block, so the bar is 16px too wide and is pushed back during the last 16px of the scroll. The fixture header has no margin of its own, so the test injects MB's 16px.

name: the feature never lets go once engaged
why: The class stays on after the overflow is gone, which is what the WIP.2 lock-on bug looked like from outside.

name: _sphNativeStyle() reads live values instead of what it saw first
why: Once marked, an element's live position is this feature's sticky, so a plain MB header reads as natively sticky on the second pass and loses SPH_Z_CHROME (106).

name: the collapsed sidebar's transform is kept while engaged
why: KNOWN BLIND SPOT, live-only. WIP.2: on the real page #page is display: table and #sidebar its right-hand cell, so translateX(100%) leaves a ghost box (and a dead scroll area) past the end of #page, and every bar is dragged along during the last part of the scroll. The fixtures load WITHOUT MusicBrainz's stylesheet: measured 2026-10-02, the collapsed #sidebar is then a 0-width display: block box BELOW #content (rect.right 10, document scrollWidth unchanged by the transform), so the ghost cannot exist and no fixture assertion can see this guard. Needs a live spec.
grep: pins header, entity header, tabs, h2 bars and footer

name: <body>'s margins are not zeroed while engaged
why: WIP.2: while engaged <body> is fit-content wide; with its own margins left in place (8px UA, or MB's margin: auto) it does not shrink back to the viewport once the overflow is gone. Caught by the ratchet test only (measured per test, 2026-10-02): the pinning tests stay green because every offset is derived from the same, consistently shifted geometry.

name: every ResizeObserver notification schedules a refresh again
why: The ported behaviour before WIP.4: height-only notifications (a sort re-appending rows) each schedule a pass that forces a layout of the whole table. Measured on artist-events: 4-7 passes per sort, up to 253 ms.
grep: a sort triggers no refresh pass

name: the width gate drops every notification
why: Over-correction guard: a gate that never schedules would also pass the "no pass on sort" half; the positive control (a table getting wider) must catch it.
grep: a sort triggers no refresh pass
